states_captured.design_decision_context: Owner gate HG-KIOSK-LOCKED-CUSTOMER-SURFACE (2026-04-27) explicitly chose LOCKED customer surface — staff intervention via caisse, not kiosk UI. This is deliberate, not an oversight. But it assumes staff is TRAINED + PRESENT, which contradicts 'newbie alone at night' persona.

findings.title: kiosk.error.call_staff button emit is BLACK-HOLE — not wired to any parent listener
findings.evidence: KioskErrorNetworkComponent.vue:46 declares emits ['retry', 'call-staff']. KioskErrorNetworkComponent.vue:66 emits 'call-staff'. KioskAppComponent.vue:124-127 ONLY listens @add-to-cart, @go-to-cart, @start-order, @reset-kiosk. No router-view ancestor catches @call-staff. Clicking the secondary 'Prevenir un membre de l'equipe' button on network-error screen fires logEvent('error_call_staff') analytics ping only — no toast, no caisse notification, no audio alert, no LED. Customer + newbie staff get ZERO observable feedback.
findings.impact: Customer believes staff was alerted; newbie staff has no panel/alert showing 'kiosk #X needs help'; both wait silently. UX trust broken.
findings.fix_proposal: Either (a) wire @call-staff in KioskAppComponent.vue to dispatch a kiosk-help-requested event over WebSocket to caisse + POS toast OR (b) remove the button entirely + reword hint TEXT to 'please go to the counter'. Currently button is misleading.

findings.title: No customer-help affordance on idle / categories / wizard / payment / cart — only on network-error screen
findings.evidence: i18n grep across kiosk lang FR: exactly 1 actionable staff button key (kiosk.error.call_staff). 5 other mentions are passive paragraph TEXT in error states (tpe_stuck_help, payment_sync_failed, offline_abandoned_one/many, payment_sync_failed) which require customer to read French + walk to counter unaided. NO help button on idle screen (S1+S2). NO help button on categories. NO help button in wizard (S5 scenario 3). NO inline '?' tooltip anywhere.
findings.impact: Newbie staff alone at night cannot remotely see which kiosk needs help. Customer with confusion (wizard 5 steps, payment error, allergen question) has zero self-help. Owner gate HG-KIOSK-LOCKED-CUSTOMER-SURFACE chose this on purpose — but the gate assumed trained staff watching. Newbie-alone persona breaks the assumption.
findings.fix_proposal: Either (a) accept gate decision + add MANDATORY staff training procedure doc (runbook 'borne-customer-support-V1.md') OR (b) revisit gate with owner: add a discrete 'i' help icon top-right that opens a modal showing FAQ + 'Call staff' button that fires WebSocket signal to caisse. Currently the gate + zero runbook = newbie hire night = customer abandons + lost revenue + bad review.

Listener exists in routes/channels.php (verified). No frozen-zone touch on KioskAppComponent strictly required if signal originates from offline-queue helper.

self_red_team_questions: Q: Is the LOCKED-customer surface actually the right design? A: Owner gate 2026-04-27 explicitly approved it for V1. Reopening = scope creep. Findings B1-P6-F02 proposes runbook + optional Phase B, not gate reversal.

Q: Is the dead @call-staff emit a real defect? A: YES — verified by direct read of KioskAppComponent:124-127 (no @call-staff listener) + KioskErrorNetworkComponent:66 (emit fires). Analytics ping is the only side effect.

Q: Is 'newbie staff alone at night' a real V1 persona? A: Yes — Le Cayenne V1 LOCAL single-resto context implies skeleton crew at non-peak hours. CLAUDE.md §2 mentions 'staff (branch_id>0) scoped' — does not assume training depth.

Q: Are the passive TEXT mentions ('please alert staff') sufficient? A: For trained staff watching, yes. For newbie alone + unfamiliar customer, NO — no audio, no visual signal on POS, no LED. Pure text in French = single point of failure.
adversarial_dispute.convergence_after_self_dispute: Findings hold. F01 (P1) is unambiguous defect (dead emit). F02 (P0) is design-gate question — proposes runbook fix (no frozen touch) as V1.0 + optional UI revisit as V1.0.X backlog. F03 (P1) is cross-surface signal gap — fixable without frozen-zone touch via offline-queue helper + existing Reverb channel.

verdict: P0=1 (F02 — missing newbie-staff runbook + no help affordance design), P1=2 (F01 dead emit, F03 cross-surface gap). Frozen-zone diff: 0 LOC required for F02 runbook + F03 cross-surface fix. F01 fix touches FROZEN KioskAppComponent (would need LOCK). The borne is DELIBERATELY locked per owner gate — but the gate assumes trained staff. Newbie-alone persona is unsupported by current docs+UI. NF525 chain not affected by any finding.
